title: doria
intro: Doria, commonly known as Dorianum or Dorian plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, known for its potential health benefits, therapeutic actions, and bioactive constituents. The health benefits of Doria plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Doria plant include its use in traditional medicine for treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
